The MOBI6 part's compiled NCX (INDX) has 14 entries; in record order fileposes 876, 1020, 1361, 2402, 11242, 19401, 30183, 39732, 48216, 55108, 60013, 68798, 73934, 1515 — the copyright entry (1515) is stored last but is a child of 'SAM'L GABRIEL SONS…' in the tree.

notes: Moon+'s chapter list is the NCX tree flattened in document order, with chapter 0 (front matter, listed under the book title) first: 0 title, 1 THE "STORYLAND" SERIES, 2 ALICE'S ADVENTURES IN WONDERLAND, 3 SAM'L GABRIEL SONS & COMPANY NEW YORK, 4 Copyright…, 5 I—DOWN THE RABBIT-HOLE … 14 X—ALICE'S EVIDENCE. So chapter I is 5. Indexing the MOBI6 NCX in record order would give 4 (the copyright entry is stored last), and readsync's fileposes[chapter] would give 3.

Which half Moon+ reads (MOBI6 or KF8) is unknown: Moon+'s MOBI loader is native (MLoader) and both halves carry the same text. The rendering is styled (centred heading and image, paragraph spacing). Against a naive tag-strip of the MOBI6 half from filepos 2402: Moon+ 2 / 24 / 616 vs naive 2 / 23 / 613 (the illustration before Z3 appears to count).
Chapter 0 opens with an image: its .po is 0@0#1, as in Pride and Prejudice.
The last chapter (X) runs to the end of the text, Gutenberg licence included: 15 pages, end of book at offset 21378.
